poses.caption: Sit with your chest and upper arms against the preacher pad. Hold the handles with palms facing each other and lower them under control.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and curl the handles toward your shoulders. Pause, then lower slowly with straight wrists.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male anatomical illustration canonical1615 LEVER HAMMER GRIP PREACHER CURL. TWO equal square panels side by side WIDE2:1 landscape, same person machine viewpoint scale. Front three-quarter side camera showing BOTH elbows resting fixed on wide inclined dark gray preacher pad, chest supported against upper edge, seated upright feet flat. Realistic compact gray lever curl machine, single mechanical pivot at elbow axis beside pad, rigid paired lever arms to TWO vertical cylindrical handles. Hands NEUTRAL HAMMER GRIP palms face EACH OTHER thumbs UP throughout. LEFT START upper arms lie along slope of preacher pad, elbows almost straight not hyperextended, forearms follow pad DOWN away from torso to vertical handles. RIGHT FINISH same upper arms pinned to same pad same elbows position, flex elbows to bring vertical handles close toward shoulders; forearms angle upward, lever rotates around SAME fixed pivot. Machine seat pad base pivot identical both panels. Hands fully grip vertical handles with five fingers each, wrists straight. Both exposed BICEPS highlighted RED only. Detailed crisp grayscale anatomical skin realistic proportions equal male/female quality. Full opaque solid BLACK tank wraps front sides back and BLACK mid-thigh shorts cover front sides back seat crotch with intact seams folds hems. No cutaways transparency or muscle fibers through fabric. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft shadows generous margins, entire head both hands feet whole machine fully within EACH square no cropped parts. Reference original artwork STYLE ONLY ignore pushup pose and chest highlighting. No labels text captions arrows extra figures.
jobs.inspectionNote: Two lever hammer-grip preacher curl candidates, four poses, two built-in calls. Real outputs inspected: neutral vertical handles, supported upper arms, extended to flexed elbows, red exposed biceps, opaque tank and shorts, complete bodies and machine frames. Qualified human review needed for exact elbow/pivot alignment, maintained pad contact, finger anatomy, resistance linkage and range. Female machine includes weight stack; male uses compact lever frame with resistance mechanism not fully established. Equivalent detailed rendering retained. Original artwork style only, no upstream media. Exact prompts and masters retained. No anatomical approval or publication.
